items.situation: student asking about a reading list for a course
items.speaker: Why isn't the reading list posted yet?

options.A: I've got last term's copy if you want it.
options.B: The reading room is on the second floor.
options.C: I'm meeting my cousin for dinner tonight.
options.D: Yes, three chapters and one article.

items.explanation: 说话人抱怨书单还没发。正确答 A 不去解释「为什么没发」，而是直接解决对方真正的需求——把上学期的书单借给他（context_shift），这是真实口语里最自然的回应。B 借用 reading 一词跳到「阅览室在二楼」，只做词汇联想，不回应问题（语义联想陷阱）。C 说晚上和表亲吃饭，与话题毫无关系（完全离题）。D 回答的是「书单上有几篇」，答的是 what 而不是 why（答非所问）。

items.situation: expressing concern about a friend's situation
items.speaker: Where's Daniel been hiding all week?

options.A: He hid the spare key under the mat.
options.B: Have you tried texting him yourself?
options.D: The dining hall closes at eight now.

items.explanation: 说话人关心 Daniel 一周没露面。正确答 B 用一个反问「你自己给他发消息了吗」把对话推进一步（counter_question），既回应了关心又给出可行动作。A 抓住 hiding 的字面义，说他把备用钥匙藏在垫子下，是同词不同义的曲解（语义联想/一词多义陷阱）。C 回答「从周一下午起」，答的是 when 而不是 where（答非所问）。D 说食堂八点关门，与话题无关（完全离题）。

items.situation: offering help to someone who seems stressed
items.speaker: You look like you could use a hand.

options.A: My hand still hurts from yesterday.
options.B: The bus schedule changed again this month.
options.C: Thanks, could you take this box?
options.D: No, I've never used that machine.

items.explanation: 说话人主动提出帮忙。正确答 C 直接接受帮助并指明要帮什么（direct_topical），是被搭话一方最自然的回应。A 把 a hand（帮把手）当成字面的「手」，说手还疼，是典型的一词多义陷阱。B 说公交时刻表又改了，与当下情境无关（完全离题）。D 说「我没用过那台机器」，答的是「你用过吗」这类问题，不是对提议的回应（答非所问）。

items.situation: student asking about dorm maintenance issue
items.speaker: What's taking maintenance so long with the heater?

options.A: The heater in the lounge is brand new.
options.B: I signed up for the cooking class.
options.C: In the basement, next to the laundry.
options.D: Actually, they came by this morning.

items.explanation: 说话人抱怨维修迟迟不来修暖气。正确答 D 以话语标记 Actually 开头，间接纠正对方的前提——其实他们今早已经来过了（marker_led_indirect）。A 借 heater 一词转去描述休息室那台是新的，答非本题（语义联想陷阱）。B 说自己报了烹饪课，与话题无关（完全离题）。C 回答「在地下室，洗衣房旁边」，答的是 where 而不是 what（答非所问）。

items.situation: acknowledging someone's unavailability or schedule conflict
items.speaker: I can't make it to Thursday's rehearsal.

options.A: No worries, we'll fill you in.
options.B: The rehearsal room has a new piano.
options.C: She arrived on the earlier train.
options.D: Sure, I'll make one for you too.

items.explanation: 说话人说周四排练来不了。正确答 A 用两个口语套话 No worries 和 fill you in（回头把情况告诉你）轻松化解（idiomatic），语气自然温和。B 借 rehearsal 一词去说排练室换了新钢琴，只做词汇联想（语义联想陷阱）。C 说「她坐早一班车到的」，人物与时间都对不上（完全离题）。D 把 make it（赶到）误解成 make（做一个），是一词多义陷阱。

items.situation: coordinating airport pickup with a friend
items.speaker: Do you know when Priya's flight gets in?

options.A: She always books the aisle seat.
options.B: Don't worry, I'll collect her myself.
options.C: The parking garage raised its rates.
options.D: At the terminal three arrivals gate.

items.explanation: 说话人问航班几点到，背后的真实需求是「谁去接机」。正确答 B 不报时间，而是直接把接机这件事接过来（context_shift），正是真题最典型的间接应答。A 借 flight 联想到她总订靠走道的座位，与到达时间无关（语义联想陷阱）。C 说停车场涨价了，属于沾边但无用的信息（完全离题）。D 回答「在三号航站楼到达口」，答的是 where 而不是 when（答非所问）。

items.situation: friend sharing news or personal update
items.speaker: How's your sister taking the news?

options.A: I took the news magazine home.
options.B: The bakery on Elm closed last month.

items.explanation: 说话人问姐姐对这个消息反应如何。正确答 C 用习语 over the moon（欣喜若狂）直接描述她的反应（idiomatic），简短自然。A 把 taking the news 曲解成「把新闻杂志拿回家」，是同词不同义的陷阱（语义联想陷阱）。B 说榆树街的面包店上个月关了，与话题无关（完全离题）。D 回答「大概周五深夜」，答的是 when 而不是 how（答非所问）。

items.situation: student seeking help at the writing center
items.speaker: Can someone look at my draft before Friday?

options.A: The writing center moved upstairs last term.
options.B: I finally replaced my bicycle tire.
options.C: Because the deadline moved up a week.
options.D: Well, we do have a morning slot open.

items.explanation: 学生问周五前能否有人看他的初稿。正确答 D 以 Well 开头，间接地给出可行方案——上午还有空位（marker_led_indirect），既没直说 yes 也推进了对话。A 借 writing center 去说它上学期搬到楼上了，只谈位置不回应请求（语义联想陷阱）。B 说自己换了自行车轮胎，与话题无关（完全离题）。C 回答「因为截止日提前了一周」，答的是 why 而不是能不能（答非所问）。

items.situation: student asking about the last campus shuttle of the night
items.speaker: When's the last shuttle tonight?

options.A: I'm driving that way, hop in.
options.B: The shuttle got a new paint job.
options.C: My roommate adopted a cat last week.
options.D: From the stop behind the gym.

items.explanation: 说话人问末班校车几点，真正的需求是「怎么回去」。正确答 A 不报时间，而是直接提出捎他一程（context_shift）。B 借 shuttle 一词去说车重新喷了漆，与时间无关（语义联想陷阱）。C 说室友上周领养了猫，与话题毫无关系（完全离题）。D 回答「在体育馆后面那站」，答的是 where 而不是 when（答非所问）。

items.situation: friend admitting they have been procrastinating
items.speaker: I've been putting off that dentist appointment.

options.A: My dentist's office has a nice view.
options.B: They repaved the road near the park.
options.C: What's stopping you from calling today?

items.explanation: 说话人承认一直拖着不去看牙医。正确答 C 用反问「今天打个电话有什么难的呢」把对话往前推（counter_question），既回应了对方的自嘲又给出行动方向。A 借 dentist 去夸诊所视野好，只做词汇联想（语义联想陷阱）。B 说公园旁边的路重铺了，与话题无关（完全离题）。D 回答「一般每六个月一次」，答的是「多久去一次」，不是对拖延这件事的回应（答非所问）。
